recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It corrects the active current resource definition to match the Published Jira request and parallel FM artifacts without editing retired source or generated diagrams.
issue_request: FHIR-17957 was a Published/Persuasive Financial Management change request for STU3 EligibilityRequest asking that the .priority terminology description use the lower-case code value "stat" instead of "STAT".
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in the large GF#17957 spreadsheet update f369c813fb, which changed CoverageEligibilityRequest.priority away from the older "Immediate (STAT), best effort (NORMAL), deferred (DEFER)" wording. The ProcessPriority binding description still retained "STAT, normal, Deferred", and later structured XML conversion preserved that stale wording.
additional_context: EligibilityRequest is retained only as renamed/out-of-build historical source in the current checkout, while CoverageEligibilityRequest is active and approved in source/fhir.ini. Parallel active Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit priority bindings already use "stat, normal, deferred", and community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: Changed source/coverageeligibilityrequest/structuredefinition-CoverageEligibilityRequest.xml so the ProcessPriority binding description lists "stat, normal, deferred". The legacy EligibilityRequest spreadsheet was intentionally left unchanged because it is not the current-build artifact.
